title: Meet My Phantoms highlight the struggle of personal growth in “Harder Than It Needs To Be”
htmlContent:
Some battles happen quietly, and Meet My Phantoms reveals this in their new single, "Harder Than It Needs To Be." This deeply personal song explores feelings of self-doubt, the strength to keep going, and the challenging yet beautiful process of change.

The song pulls you into a world of self-reflection, filled with beautiful melodies that feel close and expansive simultaneously. Meet My Phantoms openly addresses the struggles of change, thriving in that discomfort with a relatable vulnerability. The music creates a back-and-forth feeling that mirrors the inner struggle of accepting oneself. The contrasts throughout the track, soft yet powerful, calm yet overflowing with emotion, make it stand out.

https://open.spotify.com/track/2uF4JbMp2LQyb7TD98s8iT?si=3LjYI1UXS8SkwbVcohhYPQ

"Harder Than It Needs To Be" speaks to everyone, encouraging listeners to think about their own challenges and moments of determination. It serves as a reminder that while growing can be challenging, it's always a journey worth taking. With this release, Meet My Phantoms establishes themselves as brave enough to tackle the ups and downs of life.
